```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Court claims that “agency fees” impinge on the individual freedom of workers subject to them.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Court has long recognized that states may choose to negotiate with unions “agency fee” or “union security” clauses as all workers benefit from the provisions of the union contract.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"“Agency fee” or “union security” clauses give employees the right not to contribute to the political activity of unions while requiring all workers covered by the contract to pay the per capita cost of the union representing them.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If workers are given the “right” to “free ride” on the cost of unions negotiating better working conditions for all workers, such free-riding can deny unions the revenue necessary to represent their workers in an effective manner.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A proper analogy to “right to work” legislation would be a law allowing citizens to refuse to pay taxes for the services from which they benefit.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Court majority claims it will not revisit the 1977 ruling in Abood v. Detroit Board of Education that found legal “agency fee” provisions in collective bargaining agreements between public sector unions and government entities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The four most conservative judges indicated that they would welcome further challenges to “agency fee” agreements by “directly employed” public employees.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The four most conservative judges implied that they would likely rule that all “agency fee” agreements violate the right of the individual to choose not to pay any funds to the union.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
